text: Hello and welcome to live coverage of the Premier League clash between West Ham and Nottingham Forest at London Stadium.
West Ham beat Olympiakos in midweek to move to the top of Group A in the Europa League and will be looking to continue their momentum into the Premier League.
The Hammers have lost their last three top-flight matches against Aston Villa, Everton and Brentford, conceding eight goals.
David Moyes’ men won three of their first four games but have only secured one victory in their previous seven fixtures.
As a result, they have dropped down to 13th place.

However, West Ham will take encouragement from the fact that they have triumphed in four of their last five Premier League home matches against Forest, with their only defeat coming back in January 1997.
Forest ended their six-game winless run with an impressive 2-0 win over in-form Aston Villa at the City Ground in their previous outing.
Ola Aina's strike from outside the box put Steve Cooper's men ahead after five minutes, with Orel Mangala doubling Forest's advantage soon after half-time.

The Tricky Trees' first league win since the start of September has pushed them seven points clear of the relegation zone, but they will have to perform better on their travels if they want to make it back-to-back victories.
They have lost 17 games away from home since the start of the 2022-23 season and failed to score on 13 occasions (including their previous three on the road).
West Ham make three changes to the side that beat Olympiakos in the Europa League.
Areola returns to take his usual Premier League place in goal for the Hammers, with Fabianski dropping onto the bench.
Captain Zouma returns after missing the last few matches and comes in for Mavropanos.
Soucek also starts instead of Benrahma in the midfield.
Unsurprisingly, Forest name the same team that started their 2-0 win over Villa in their previous Premier League outing.
They are also boosted by the return of Origi and Wood to the squad, with the pair back from injury.
Forest have won just two of their last 17 top-flight meetings with West Ham (drawing seven and losing eight), with both wins coming by a 1-0 scoreline in January 1997 and August last season.
Both teams are on the pitch and are ready to get started.
Forest get this Premier League clash under way.
Forest manager Cooper will be hoping that his Forest side will take encouragement from their win over Villa in their previous match to claim a rare away win in the league.

Among managers to take charge of at least 25 Premier League matches, only Nigel Worthington (21.2 per cent) and Brian McDermott (21.7 per cent) have won a lower percentage of their points in away games than Nottingham Forest manager Steve Cooper (12 out of 51, 23.5 per cent).
GOALLL! WHAT A START FOR WEST HAM! 1-0! The hosts have the lead inside three minutes.
Dominguez looks to lift the ball over to the right, but his pass deflects off of a team-mate and straight to Paqueta.
He has possession outside the box and strikes his effort into the bottom corner.
West Ham break forward again through Ward-Prowse, who slides a pass down the left to Emerson.
He looks to whip a cross into the box, but Aina makes the block.
West Ham have been brilliant in the opening seven minutes of the match and already have the lead.
Kudus is looking energetic on the right and is trying to get on the ball as much as possible.
However, he has not had a chance to run at Toffolo.
Niakhate launches a long throw-in into the box that is headed away by Alvarez.
It comes back to the centre-back, but his pass is tame and Soucek pokes it clear.
Coufal darts down the right with possession and plays a quick one-two with Kudus.
He is up against Elanga, with the Forest man doing well to force the ball out for a goal-kick.
Coufal is furious with the referee as he thinks West Ham should have a corner.
SAVE! What a stop from Areola.
Gibbs-White's cross from the right is heavy, but Elanga does well to recover it on the other side before rolling a pass back to Toffolo.
He then curls a cross onto the head of Awoniyi, who has his effort pushed away by Areola.
Niakhate has a throw-in on the left, but it is poor and West Ham break away with speed.
Kudus rushes through the middle and has Ward-Prowse to his right but decides to go to Paqueta on his left.
He looks to score his second goal of the game, but his effort is tame.
Ward-Prowse is frustrated that the ball didn't go to him.
Murillo was defending against Paqueta and slips in front of him before Vlachodimos made a simple save.

source.label: assist
source.text: Paqueta and slips in front of him

text: He seems hurt and needs medical attention, but will be fine to continue.
West Ham were by far the better team in the opening 10 minutes, but Forest are starting to grow into the game and are keeping possession well.
Awoniyi looks to poke a fast throughball into the path of Elanga, but his pass is intercepted.
Kudus rolls past Toffolo before being pushed in the back by Mangala.
West Ham still have possession, but the referee gives a free-kick.
Moyes wanted the game to continue with his team on the ball.
Coufal has space on the right and he lofts a deep cross over to Paquetá at the back of the box.
He shapes to shoot on the volley but instead attempts to play a pass inside, allowing Forest to clear the ball away.
Elanga isolates Coufal on the left.
He pushes the ball past the right-back before getting fouled.
Coufal is then shown the first yellow card of the game.
Toffolo plays a ball down the right and slides a pass down the wing to Elanga, who wins a corner off Coufal.
Gibbs-White looks for options in the middle, but Areola punches it away.
Although nothing comes of the attack, Forest will be encouraged by Elanga's ability to challenge Coufal, who is on a yellow card.
Coufal is being challenged defensively but is having a lot of joy in the attack.
He chests the ball past Elanga and sends a searching cross into the box, but it is just beyond Bowen in the middle.
All of Forest's attacks are coming down the left.
Elanga pokes the ball through Coufal's legs and rushes around the other side.
He has time to find an option in the heart of the box but sends his cross straight into the gloves of Areola.
West Ham are clever in possession on the right.
Ward-Prowse cuts a pass across to Soucek, who attempts to curl a pass down the right of the box to Bowen.
However, he is tracked by Niakhate, who lets the ball go out for a goal-kick.
Ward-Prowse is pulling the strings for West Ham.
He has possession on the left and looks to curl a pass into the feet of Bowen, but Vlachodimos reads his intentions and rushes off his line to claim it.

West Ham have won just six of their last 34 Premier League matches against sides who aren’t newly promoted to the division that season (drawing eight and losing 20), with two of those wins coming against sides relegated last season (1-0 v Southampton in April, 3-1 v Leeds in May).
They have been the better side so far and are putting Forest under pressure down the wings.
Sangare trips Kudus, who was breaking into Forest's half.
He is fortunate not to be shown a yellow card that would see him miss their next game against Brighton.
Elanga collects a direct pass on the byline and wins a corner off Coufal, who is having an indifferent game against the winger.
Gibbs-White sends an inswinging corner into the box, but Areola punches it away.
Forest work the ball back to Gibbs-White.
However, his second cross is cleared away and Forest are forced back.
The former Wolves man will be disappointed with his deliveries into the box so far.
WIDE! Forest break away through Gibbs-White, but his flicked pass is poor and West Ham have it back.
Kudus finds Bowen, who has a cross blocked.
The hosts recycle possession back to Alvarez, who strikes a shot well wide from distance.
Paqueta and Gibbs-White battle for the ball in the air, with the West Ham man coming off worse.
There are some concerns around London Stadium with the Brazil international staying down, but he returns to his feet after a short period on the floor.
Kudus looks to rush past Toffolo on a couple of occasions, but the left-back gets the better of the West Ham man to win possession.
Kudus has not had a lot of luck down the right, with most of his best work coming down the middle third of the pitch.

West Ham’s Bowen has been involved in 10 goals in his last 12 Premier League starts (eight goals and two assists), although only three of those have come at the London Stadium (two goals and one assist).
He has had a quiet half up front and has not had a lot of service.
Coufal has another chance to find him in the box but sends his cross straight out for a goal-kick.
GOALLL! AWONIYI SCORES! 1-1! Forest are level! Sangare wins possession in the midfield and sends a pass down the right to Gibbs-White.
He gets the better of Emerson and drives a low shot across the goal that is pushed away by Areola.
However, Awoniyi is free and he taps the ball in from close range.
Awoniyi has scored six of Nottingham Forest's last eight away goals in the Premier League.
There will be three minutes of additional time.
West Ham will be frustrated with the late goal that they have conceded.
They were controlling the pace of the game and were putting some nice passing moves together outside the box, but couldn't add to their early goal.
HALF-TIME: WEST HAM 1-1 NOTTINGHAM FOREST
Awoniyi scored just before half-time to send West Ham and Forest into the break level at 1-1.
The Hammers were the better side in the opening exchanges and scored inside three minutes.
Paqueta made the most of a poor pass from Dominguez and drilled his low shot into the bottom corner.

events.action: drilled his low shot into the bottom corner

text: Awoniyi thought he netted the equaliser later on, but his header was saved excellently by Areola.
Paqueta had a shot saved, and Alvarez missed the target with an ambitious effort before Forest were level.
Gibbs-White got the better of Emerson down the right and had a low shot across the goal pushed away by the goalkeeper.
However, Awoniyi was there for the rebound and had a simple finish.
West Ham looked in control after scoring after three minutes but struggled to create noteworthy opportunities.
They only accumulated an expected goals (xG) of 0.35 compared to Forest's 1.12 and were forced to keep possession outside the opposition's box.
Bowen usually plays on the wing but has struggled up front, only having five touches in the half.
As for Forest, they have been bright in spells and deserved their equaliser.
Elanga was one of their best players and constantly looked to beat Coufal on the left, with the right-back having to be careful after being shown a yellow card.
Dominguez gifted West Ham the opener and is now coming off after a poor performance in the first half.
Danilo takes his place in the midfield.
West Ham get the ball rolling again.
Bowen weaves his way through Forest's defence on the right and pokes a pass into the heart of the box.
Emerson tries to get there before Vlachodimos, but the goalkeeper gets down to claim it.
CHANCE! Forest should have taken the lead.
Vlachodimos launches the ball up the pitch, with Awoniyi allowed to take it down inside West Ham's half.
He combines with Elanga and moves into the box before dragging a shot wide.
The second half has started with chances at either end.
This time Ward-Prowse has the ball and lays it into the feet of Emerson.
He strides past a couple of Forest players before driving his shot across the goal and wide from outside the box.
West Ham have lost their last three Premier League games, last enduring a longer losing run at the end of 2022, when they lost their final five games of last year.
They will be hoping to stop Forest's momentum in the game after their late goal just before half-time.
Coufal wins a corner on the right and Ward-Prowse walks over to take it.
His outswinging corner is headed away by Murillo, with Emerson's cross back into the box poor.
Forest rush forward on the counter through Elanga, who has possession on the left.
He moves inside and has a shot blocked, with Gibbs-White lashing over the rebound.
Both of their chances in the half have come through West Ham corners.
Niakhate goes into the book after blocking Emerson.
Ward-Prowse is over a free-kick on the left near the corner flag.
He goes for a shot, but his effort goes just over, hitting the top of the net on the way through.
He shouts for a corner after Vlachodimos stretches his arm towards the ball, but a goal-kick is given.
There have already been more shots in the second half than in the first.
Both teams are pushing players forward to try and take the lead, which has allowed the game to be more open in the midfield.
Awoniyi wins a free-kick just inside West Ham's half, with Forest loading the box.
Toffolo's cross looks to be going straight to Areola, but Aguerd gets in the way and the hosts have to hack it clear.
Kudus makes a lunging tackle on Toffolo and goes into the book.
Ward-Prowse wins possession and West Ham come forward on the counter.
Paqueta finds Bowen, who holds up the ball before spinning past Murillo.
The Forest defender pulls him back before winning it back.
There is shock around the stadium that a foul is not given against the defender.
GOALLLL! ELANGA SCORES! 2-1 FOREST! What a turnaround from the away side.
Aina rushes down the right and looks for options in the middle.
He cuts a low cross into the heart of the box, with Elanga arriving in the middle.
He is free and he curls his low shot into the bottom corner.

events.action: curls his low shot into the bottom corner

text: Aina was superb at going forward against Villa in the last match but hasn't been able to be as free down the right in this game.
However, he gets an assist after spotting the run across the box from Elanga.
Elanga takes off his shirt and is shown a yellow card.
GOALLL! WHAT A RESPONSE FROM WEST HAM! 2-2! Forest's lead didn't last long! Ward-Prowse's excellent inswinging corner finds Bowen, who heads the ball across the goal and into the top corner.

events.action: heads the ball across the goal and into the top corner

text: What a signing Ward-Prowse has been for West Ham.
The former Southampton captain gets his fourth Premier League assist of the season with another pinpoint corner.
There were just 123 seconds between Elanga putting Forest ahead and West Ham equalising through Bowen.
BAR! West Ham should have the lead for a second time.
Aina directs Alvarez's direct pass straight into the path of Soucek, who crashes the bar with a first-time effort.
Cooper will be shocked at the way the game has got away from Forest in the last few minutes.
Forest have a chance to put the ball in the box after winning a free-kick on the left.
However.
Gibbs-White's cross is poor and West Ham come forward.
Kudus takes the ball down brilliantly on the right and plays a pass inside to Ward-Prowse, who sees his low shot deflect wide.
However, nothing comes from the following corner.
Forest are about to make a couple of changes.
Kudus has been fantastic on the right.
He drives inside from the wing and feeds a pass into the path of Bowen.
The England international looks to return possession to his team-mate, but the ball is intercepted.
Emerson then gives away a cheap foul.
Forest make three changes.
Murillo went down twice and cannot continue.
Boly replaces him at centre-back.
Cooper makes a straight swap in the attack.
Awoniyi scored Forest's first goal and is now coming off after a good performance up front.
Wood is back from injury and takes his place.
Aina is also given a rest.
Aurier is on at right-back in his place.
West Ham are yet to make a change in this match with Moyes happy with his side.
They could start to feel tired in this match after their Europa League outing during the week.
Moyes wants to win this match and has added another attacker to the mix.
Antonio replaces Alvarez.
Danilo comes forward with possession and slides a pass down the left to Elanga.
He looks to get involved in the match for the first time since scoring but slips at the crucial moment, allowing Coufal to come away with the ball.
Ward-Prowse has been over everything for West Ham.
This time he whips a deep free-kick into the heart of the box that is flicked into the middle by Soucek.
Bowen is onside and is stretching to get on the end of it, but Vlachodimos claims it.
Ward-Prowse curls a corner towards the near post, with Gibbs-White getting across to head it behind.
He puts his second cross into the same area, but Forest head it up the pitch this time and can reset.
SAVE! Vlachodimos denies West Ham again.
Ward-Prowse delivers another special cross into the heart of the box, this time from a free-kick on the left.
Soucek escapes his marker but heads the ball at Vlachodimos, who pushes it over.
The referee stops the game with Sangare on the floor after a tackle from Bowen.
However, after a few seconds, he returns to his feet.
West Ham have all the momentum and Forest are trying to disrupt their flow.
GOALLL! SOUCEK SCORES! 3-2 WEST HAM! The hosts are ahead again! Forest have struggled to defend against Ward-Prowse's crosses throughout the game.
His outswinging corner is met by Soucek, who plants his downward header into the bottom corner.

events.action: plants his downward header into the bottom corner

text: If West Ham win this match, it will be down to Ward-Prowse.
He gets his second assist from a corner.
This time from the right, his cross finds the head of Soucek, who beats Vlachodimos with a header.
Forest need a goal and are bringing on another striker.
Origi comes on for Sangare.
There will be seven minutes of additional time.
Gibbs-White's corner in is high, but Zouma gets it away.
Kudus rushes down the right and plays a pass inside to Paqueta, who has options rushing ahead of him.
He attempts to find an option down the right, but Danilo gets back well to intercept.
Origi has possession on the edge of the box and has Gibbs-White to his right, but shifts the ball onto his left foot and blasts a shot towards the goal.
However, his effort is straight at Areola, who pushes it over.
West Ham are shutting the doors on Forest and put another defender on the pitch before a Forest free-kick.
Ogbonna is on for Kudus.
Gibbs-White is over a free-kick on the right and has options in the middle.
However, his cross has too much height on it and Areola claims it.
Niakhate has a throw-in on the right and is encouraging players forward.
However, his hopeful ball into the box is poor and Soucek heads it away.
West Ham come forward on the counter through Paqueta, who looks for Ward-Prowse on the inside.
His shot from outside the box is blocked.
West Ham make a change with seconds remaining.
Veteran Cresswell comes on to try and protect the Hammers' lead.
Paqueta makes way.
FULL-TIME: WEST HAM 3-2 NOTTINGHAM FOREST
West Ham came from behind to beat Nottingham Forest 3-2 in a thrilling match at the London Stadium.
The hosts broke the deadlock inside three minutes when Paqueta made the most of a loose past from Dominguez to drive a low shot into the bottom corner.
Areola denied Awoniyi's header from close range but could do nothing about Forest's leveller.
Gibbs-White got the better of Emerson on the right before having his shot saved, but Awoniyi tapped in the rebound.
There were then two goals inside 123 seconds.
Elanga directed Aina's cutback into the corner to give Cooper's side the lead, only for Bowen to equalise soon after.
He got on the end of a Ward-Prowse corner and powered his header into the top corner.

events.action: powered his header into the top corner

text: Soucek crashed the bar and forced a smart stop out of Vlachodimos before scoring the winner.
Ward-Prowse delivered another pinpoint corner, with Soucek's downward header beating the goalkeeper.
After the international break, West Ham head to Burnley in the Premier League.
As for Forest, they host Brighton.
That's all for today, goodbye.
